Pixel Smash

AD dash and run W or Space jump S crouch, fast fall, double tap to drop P jab a held WASD then P tilts, pressed together with P it smashes (hold P to charge) Space + P short hop aerial Shift walk O special, add a direction for side, up or down I shield, with a direction roll, with S spot dodge, in the air air dodge, release just before a hit to parry U grab, or I + P. While holding, P pummels and a direction throws.
